title: MLLM-as-a-Judge: Assessing Multimodal LLM-as-a-Judge with Vision-Language Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the scores models assign to their own generated responses versus responses generated by other models to detect self-preference.

Evaluating if models consistently favor answers placed in specific positions (e.g., always preferring the first option 'A') during pair comparison and batch ranking tasks regardless of answer quality.

Analyzing the correlation between response length and assigned scores, including conducting experiments that artificially increase the semantic length of answers without changing their intent to observe if the assigned scores increase.
Analyzing the score distribution in scoring evaluation tasks to identify a disproportionate tendency of models to assign high ratings (e.g., predominantly assigning 4s) and avoid lower scores.
